## Use FiraFlott in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set FiraFlott for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'FiraFlott', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

## About the FiraFlott coding font

A fluid variant of Fira Code. FiraFlott is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

FiraFlott is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## FiraFlott FAQ

### Is FiraFlott free?

Yes. FiraFlott is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does FiraFlott support ligatures?

Yes. FiraFlott ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get FiraFlott?

FiraFlott is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
